tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. shadcn --background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, task rows, habit cards, nav bar. shadcn --card and --popover.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Filled inputs, search bar, hover on rows, unselected date pills. shadcn --muted and --secondary.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges that carry no meaning. shadcn --border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: input underlines, chip outlines, the empty task checkbox, the switch track when off. 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes. shadcn --input.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-raised. shadcn --foreground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, meta lines, labels, placeholders. 4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised in both themes. shadcn --muted-foreground.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. Fills only: primary buttons, selected chip, selected date, progress fill, active switch. Never text on a light ground. shadcn --primary.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. shadcn --primary-foreground.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent used AS text or icon: 'See all' links, the highlighted count in the greeting, active nav label, progress percent. 5:1 or better on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet accent ground: active sidebar item, today marker, soft badges. Pair with accent-ink. shadcn --accent.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Edge drawn around amber fills that show a state (selected chip, switch on, selected date) so the state reads at 3:1 even where amber is pale against the page, as in light mode.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1 on every surface. shadcn --ring.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Category tile ground (e.g. Projects). Text on it is on-pastel.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Category tile ground (e.g. Daily tasks). Text on it is on-pastel.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Category tile ground (e.g. Self care). Text on it is on-pastel.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Category tile ground (e.g. Shopping). Text on it is on-pastel.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Category tile ground (e.g. Study). Text on it is on-pastel.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lavender, butter, mint, peach and sky, in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed state text and icons on bg and surface. Always paired with a check icon or the word Done; never told apart from danger by hue alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue and destructive text, icons and delete buttons on bg and surface. Always paired with an icon or word. shadcn --destructive.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet danger ground: error alerts, the confirm dialog's icon circle, hover on danger menu items. Pair with danger text or icons; ink text reads on it too.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill (the final Delete in a confirm dialog).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and sheets. Dims the page so the modal reads first; the page behind is inert.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Greeting headline at lg (1024px) and up.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Greeting headline on phones and tablets.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the top bar, dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings: Categories, In progress, Completed.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: After completing a design project, read 60 pages.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines: times, day counts, one line descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chips, buttons at sm.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button text at md and lg.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Nav labels, weekday under the date, tiny counters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, meta line gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between task rows; inner gap in rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding at md and up.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; page gutter on tablets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on laptops; gap between panes.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page breathing room at lg.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkbox squares, small icon buttons, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Filled inputs, dialogs on phones, dropdowns.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Task rows, habit cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Category tiles, dialogs at md and up.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, search bar, date pills, switches, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and rows. Dark relies on surface steps, light gets a soft lift.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bottom nav bar, sheets, dialogs, the floating add button.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first. Styles apply from the width up, matching Tailwind v4 defaults.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones. Category tiles go from 2.2 visible to 3.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets. Bottom bar becomes the left rail; task list and detail sit side by side.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops. Rail becomes the full sidebar; three panes: nav, list, detail with notes.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Wide screens. Content stops growing at layout-content-max.

tokens.name: layout-nav-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the phone bottom bar (plus safe area inset).

tokens.name: layout-nav-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the tablet rail.

tokens.name: layout-sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the laptop sidebar.

tokens.name: layout-detail
tokens.usage: Width of the task detail and notes pane at lg.

tokens.name: layout-content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the whole shell at xl.

tokens.name: layout-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target on every screen size.
